description: A family member who receives money that is neither payroll nor a purchase. This register exists because ERPNext resolves a posting's `party` as a Dynamic Link THROUGH its `party_type`: a Party Type's name has to be the name of a real DocType, and there is no DocType for a relative. Customer, Supplier, Employee and Shareholder each have one; this is Family's.

fields.description: The person's name as a posting should read it. This IS the docname, and it is what appears in the `party` column of a Journal Entry line.
fields.label: Name

fields.description: How they are related. Recorded because 'why did money go to this person' is the first question anybody asks of these postings, and a name alone does not answer it.
fields.label: Relationship
fields.options:
Spouse
Child
Parent
Sibling
Grandchild
Grandparent
In-Law
Other

fields.description: The related-party register entry for this person, when there is one. THE TAX IDENTITY LIVES THERE AND ONLY THERE — this doctype deliberately holds no tax id, because a transfer below the IRS annual gift exclusion is not compensation for services and needs no W-9. A relative who IS paid for work should be recorded as a Contact or a Supplier instead, and the posting reclassified.
fields.label: Related Party

fields.description: Untick rather than delete. A person who no longer receives transfers still appears on every posting that already named them, and deleting the record would orphan those.
fields.label: Active

name: Family
